title: Mission, Vision and Values
description: Mission, values, principles and vision of Università della Svizzera italiana (USI).

blocks.html:
Mission, values, principles and vision of Università della Svizzera italiana (USI).

  • What we are committed to

    Mission

    As a university, we are an institution devoted to the transfer and development of knowledge, driven by the belief that knowledge is essential to the present and future of humanity.

    The mission of Università della Svizzera italiana finds its legal basis in the Law that regulates Università della Svizzera italiana. It consists of:

    • Providing quality education
    • Performing internationally relevant scientific research
    • Contributing to the development of the region and society

    In pursuing the three founding elements of our mission, we also aim to:

    • Actively contribute to the evolution of the Swiss academic system
    • Foster the values of Italian-speaking culture

    Learn more

  • What we believe

    Values

    We believe that those with a goal will find a way, and to identify the right path we draw inspiration from three core values:

    • Quality
    • Openness
    • Responsibility

    These values have their roots in our history and are in turn the roots of our present and our future.

    Learn more

  • How we act

    Our community is built and lives by the following principles:

    • Respect
    • Honesty
    • Reliability
    • Responsibility

    We put them into practice through concrete conduct and actions, helping to build a safe, respectful and welcoming environment for study and work.

    Code of Ethics

    The Code of Ethics formalises these principles and sets them out as shared points of reference that guide how members of the University act and relate to one another.

    Read the Code of Ethics

    Protection of personal integrity

    We are particularly committed to protecting personal integrity by providing dedicated measures, procedures and points of contact.

    Protection of personal integrity

  • Where we are heading

    Vision

    We aspire to become the natural choice for those yearning to grow intellectually, humanly and responsibly.

    USI aspires to be a way for the future and to be known as:

    • An institution that believes in diversity
    • A hub for great talent
    • A partner of choice for knowledge transfer
    • A knowledge lab
    • A place where senses and aesthetics are fostered alongside logic and reason
    • An exemplary and coveted employer
    • A region-wide campus
    • A driver for a sustainable society

    The goal is ambitious, but we are committed every day to making it a reality.

    Learn more

  • Our Charter

    Charter of USI

    The Charter of Università della Svizzera italiana embodies and expresses USI’s fundamental principles. It serves as a reference point for all members of our community, in their actions and reflections, enabling these principles to live every day.

    Read the Charter

    Magna Charta Universitatum

    USI signed the Magna Charta Universitatum 2020 (MCU 2020) on 13 November 2025, thereby affirming its contribution to the construction of an open, sustainable and cooperative academic space, capable of addressing the global challenges of the present with critical thinking and solidarity.
